# grouped-nf4-gemm

> Triton kernels for 4-bit MoE inference: grouped NF4/MXFP4 GEMM, INT4 GEMV, FP8 paged attention, and CPU/NVMe expert streaming. Canonical PyPI package `grouped-nf4-gemm` (flat modules `nf4_grouped`, `mxfp4_grouped`, `int4_b32`, `fp8_paged_attn`, `nvme_arena`, `mxfp4_loader`, …); `nf4gemm`, `gnf4` and `grouped-mxfp4-gemm` are lookup aliases only.

Router: a model, training, serving or fit problem → experts4bit-qlora · a packed layout, kernel, GEMM/GEMV, attention or arena primitive → grouped-nf4-gemm (this repository) · a current number → docs/claims.json · current support or status → docs/STATUS.md + docs/capabilities.json · changing public behaviour → AGENTS.md, 'When you change something'.

Read `docs/STATUS.md` before quoting a position and `docs/claims.json` before quoting a number: `status` is the vocabulary, and retired or superseded claims are not current. Division of responsibility: this project owns the packed-expert kernels (grouped NF4 and native MXFP4 GEMMs), the decode kernels (int4-b32 GEMV, FP8 paged attention, decode glue), the packing and reference operations, and the host/NVMe primitives; experts4bit-qlora owns model loading, quantization orchestration, adapters, training, residency integration and serving, and installs this package through its `[fast]` extra. Every kernel is asserted against a pure-torch reference, and nothing falls back silently on CPU: the NF4 grouped GEMM (`gemm_4bit_grouped` / `dgrad_4bit_grouped`) refuses CPU tensors with an error that names `dequant_ref`; the other kernels raise from the Triton launch or from their own CUDA+Triton check without naming a reference. Environment: Linux, NVIDIA sm_80+ with Triton ≥ 3.4 for the kernels; Python 3.11 tested.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/README.md): the problem, the mechanism, install, the CPU quickstart, the entry-point table, what is measured and what was retired
- [Solutions index](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/SOLUTIONS.md): one page per ordinary problem — symptoms, cause, install, smallest example, verification, limits, evidence
- [Capabilities (machine-readable)](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/capabilities.json): entry points, layouts, environments, limitations and claim IDs per capability; schema in [capabilities.schema.json](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/capabilities.schema.json)
- [Status](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md): the current position, including the three limits where the fused path loses
- [Claims register](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/claims.json): every number with hardware, status and evidence path ([schema](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/claims-schema.md))
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/INDEX.md): what each document is, and which are anchored research records

## Solutions

- [Grouped NF4 GEMM without bf16 materialization](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/solutions/nf4-grouped-gemm-without-bf16-materialization.md): gemm_4bit_grouped on the bitsandbytes gemm_4bit layout, dequant_ref as the oracle, dgrad for training; the bitsandbytes 0.50.0 boundary (packed 2-D inference upstream, no grouped routed-MoE contract, the backward still dequantizes for dX) and the measured boundaries by claim ID and tier
- [Native MXFP4 MoE inference](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/solutions/native-mxfp4-moe-inference.md): gemm_mxfp4_grouped and gemv_mxfp4_b32 on released e2m1/e8m0 bytes
- [INT4 decode GEMV](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/solutions/int4-decode-gemv.md): gemv_int4_b32, quant_x_rows, pack_int4_b32 and the GPTQ-style calibrated packer
- [FP8 paged attention for MoE serving](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/solutions/fp8-paged-attention-for-moe-serving.md): fp8_paged_decode_attention, fp8_kv, and the decode glue kernels; two compute paths with two support states (fp8 supported on sm_89+, f32 open under #319)
- [Stream experts from host RAM or NVMe](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/solutions/stream-moe-experts-from-host-or-nvme.md): nvme_arena bake, ArenaReader, ColdTier, RowPool, MXFP4 arenas — the kernel/storage primitives; the decision and model-level integration pages are experts4bit-qlora's
- [Verify quantized checkpoint provenance](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/solutions/verify-quantized-checkpoint-provenance.md): file_tensor_sha256, provenance_table, verify_arena_matches, the verify_provenance CLI

## API and architecture

- [Kernel contract](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/KERNEL_CONTRACT.md): op signatures and tensor layouts (NF4, MXFP4, int4-b32)
- [Tolerance contract](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/TOLERANCE_CONTRACT.md): the registered fidelity bound and its test
- [Portability](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/PORTABILITY.md): the pre-port hazard register for non-CUDA backends (port targets, not support)
- [System manifest](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/system-manifest.json): the two-repository manifest — what each package owns, capability IDs per package, the compatibility records (which consumer versions require which kernel floor), the evidence vocabulary and the invariants; byte-identical in experts4bit-qlora
- [Change-impact contract](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/docs/change-impact.json): the companion changes each class of change requires — new kernel capability, public API change, measured result, dependency floor
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/pjordanandrsn/grouped-nf4-gemm/blob/main/AGENTS.md): operational rules for coding agents — router, ownership boundary, sources of truth, public API map, build/test, rules that have bitten, change-impact rules, platform caveats
